item.title: Bonterra: Acquisition Of Corporate Philanthropy Platform Deed
item.description: Bonterra, a technology company focused on solutions for social good organizations, announced it has acquired Deed, a workplace giving and volunteering platform designed to improve employee engagement in corporate philanthropy. The acquisition aims to combine Deed’s modern employee engagement technology with Bonterra’s enterprise-grade grantmaking capabilities to create a unified platform for corporate giving, volunteering, and impact management.
